answer: The protocol links bonded collateral escrows by evidence of coordinated equivocation: for \(k\) identities, aggregate slashing scales as \(O(k^2)\), so splitting one operator across aliases such as glacier, walnut, and lantern does not dilute liability. On detection, asymmetric depreciation compounds across the linked escrows, imposing an exponential multiplier on swarm-level capital loss and making coordinated Sybil control increasingly costly.
